# mistershell_ca_certificate (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell ca certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_ca_certificate" "example" {
  name    = "corporate-ca"
  pem     = file("${path.module}/corporate-ca.pem")
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `pem` (String) Pem.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.

### Read-Only

- `days_remaining` (Number) Days remaining.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) Fingerprint sha256.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `is_ca` (Boolean) Is ca.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer.
- `not_after` (String) Not after.
- `not_before` (String) Not before.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
- `san` (Dynamic) San. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `serial` (String) Serial.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) Signature algorithm.
- `subject` (String) Subject.
- `version` (String) Version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_ca_certificate.example 123
```
